Titles.jpn: おそ松くん (1988)

Summaries.eng: The would-be hijinks of the mischievous Matsuno sextuplets are hijacked from episode one by colorful buck-toothed con man Iyami and Chibita, his bald munchkin sidekick. Nearly every episode is a standalone comedy cavalcade with the above cast as well as other quirky locals who show up in a number of different roles as the series shifts effortlessly between time periods and genres, but in most cases, Iyami and Chibita are front and center as partners in crime, a couple of sad sacks scraping by but carrying out scammy schemes in order to get rich quick

Titles.jpn: あっぱれチビ太の鬼たいじザンス
おそ松くん スイカの星からこんにちはザンス!
おそ松くん イヤミはひとり風の中
シェーッ! 六つ子ザンス!

Summaries.eng: Failing salesman Iyami tries robbing Osomatsu's house, but is foiled by the rambunctious sextuplets.

Titles.jpn: うらないは、こりごりザンス

Summaries.eng: A fortune-teller tells Iyami that three terrible things are going to happen to him that day.

Titles.jpn: 天才イヤミの化け薬ザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami, a quack doctor in a small town, schemes to discredit his more successful rival.

Titles.jpn: シェ〜ッ!! ミーはバレリーナ

Summaries.eng: Iyami's ballet school is putting on a performance in three days, but amid backstage turmoil, the prima ballerina keeps changing.Chibita falls in love with Dekapan's "daughter," Hanako, unaware that she's actually a pig

Titles.eng: Chibita's Love Falls with the Flowers
Titles.jpn: チビ太の恋はハナと散るダス

Summaries.eng: Chibita falls in love with Dekapan's "daughter," Hanako, unaware that she's actually a pig.

Titles.jpn: ナンマイダでもうけるザンス

Summaries.eng: Iyami fakes his own death in order to collect consolation money.

Titles.jpn: チビ太はママになりました

Summaries.eng: Chibita secretly takes care of an abandoned baby.

Titles.jpn: 変身! チビ太のふしぎな帽子

Summaries.eng: Chibita gets a hat that turns him into a good boy when he wears it.

Titles.eng: Making Easy Money with a Secondhand Store-zansu!
Titles.jpn: 古道具屋でボロもうけザンス

Summaries.eng: Iyami and Chibita are deceptive secondhand item dealers who are aiming for one big score.

Titles.jpn: 地獄の死神セールスマン!!

Summaries.eng: A Shinigami enlists Iyami's help to hasten the death of a sickly Osomatsu.

Titles.eng: Even Behind Bars, Iyami Never Learns!
Titles.jpn: ヘイの中でもこりないイヤミ

Summaries.eng: Iyami and Chibita are handcuffed together and on the run from the law after breaking out of jail.

Titles.eng: The Great Iyami-sensei, the Popular Author!
Titles.jpn: 売れっ子小説家イヤミ大先生

Summaries.eng: Iyami is a failed novelist who becomes popular when he starts writing outrageous lies about his neighbors.

Titles.eng: A Castle Moved In Next Door!
Titles.jpn: お城が隣に引っ越してきた!

Summaries.eng: When an Edo-era castle suddenly comes to town, the local citizens rebel against their would-be ruler, Chibita.

Titles.jpn: エイリアンをやっつけろ!

Summaries.eng: Aliens intent on invading Earth kidnap Osomatsu and Choromatsu, then replace them.

Titles.eng: Getting Your Life Saved is Expensive-zansu!
Titles.jpn: 命の恩は高くつくザンス

Summaries.eng: After Iyami saves Osomatsu's life, he demands constant, eternal gratitude.

Titles.jpn: 節約? 省エネ? ミニ六つ子!

Summaries.eng: Chibita uses a secret formula to shrink Osomatsu and his brothers as payback for mocking him.

Titles.jpn: ハタ坊、勇気を出す

Summaries.eng: Hatabou must summon courage to stand up for himself after being jailed for one of Iyami's misdeeds.

Titles.jpn: チビ太の金庫やぶり

Summaries.eng: Chibita is a former safecracker who's trying to go straight, but a detective, Iyami, keeps hounding him.

Titles.jpn: オツムの中味が入れかわる

Summaries.eng: Dr. Dekapan invents a liquid that causes people to switch psyches when they bump heads.

Titles.jpn: イヤミのアブナイ時計屋さん

Summaries.eng: Iyami and Chibita build a watermelon bomb to get revenge against Osomatsu and his brothers.

Titles.eng: Friendship! Chibita and the Cat Thief!
Titles.jpn: 友情!! チビ太とドロボウ猫

Summaries.eng: Kindhearted newspaper delivery boy Chibita takes in a thieving cat and tries to rehabilitate it.

Titles.jpn: チビ太はさすらいのガンマン

Summaries.eng: A mysterious gunslinger, Chibita, shows up at the Dekapan Ranch just in time to drive off six bullying brothers.

Titles.jpn: 名探偵! ハタ坊だジョー

Summaries.eng: When Osomatsu and the gang are invited for dinner at Iyami's posh mansion, a mystery ensues.

Titles.eng: Iyami's Body is Full of Germs!
Titles.jpn: イヤミの体はバイキンだらけ

Summaries.eng: Totoko becomes infected with personality-altering bacteria from Iyami's body.

Titles.eng: The Curse of Oden is Scary-zansu!
Titles.jpn: おでんの恨みは怖いザンス!

Summaries.eng: Chibita is framed for stealing oden.

Titles.jpn: 父さんもタバコがやめられる

Summaries.eng: Dad struggles with quitting smoking after he nearly starts a fire in the house.

Titles.eng: The Fairy Tale of Outie Island!
Titles.jpn: おとぎ話のデベソ島

Summaries.eng: On Outie Island, Dekapan and Hatabou work hard to make offerings to a stone god, while Iyami and everyone else enjoys the good life.

Titles.jpn: 野生のイヤミに気をつけろ!

Summaries.eng: When the sextuplets and Totoko go camping, they encounter Iyami, a wild man of the forest.

Titles.eng: It's Do or Die for an Insurance Agent!
Titles.jpn: 保険屋さんは命がけザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami starts an insurance company, thinking he'll take people's money and run.

Titles.jpn: 忍者チビ太、ただいま参上!

Summaries.eng: Chibita comes back to town seeking vengeance after training in the mountains to be a ninja.

Titles.eng: Up to Here with the Spirit of the Flower-zansu!
Titles.jpn: 花の精にはこりごりザンス!

Summaries.eng: The honest, hardworking Chibita is constantly targeted by the lazy thief, Iyami, but one day he finds a magical rose that changes his life.

Titles.eng: Totoko is the Number One Idol-zansu!
Titles.jpn: トト子はアイドルNo.1ザンス

Summaries.eng: When a pretty girl moves next door to Osomatsu and his brothers, Totoko is deposed as the neighborhood's number one idol.

Titles.jpn: 男の友情はあついザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami and Chibita are best friends and trapeze artists at a third-rate circus, but Totoko, the ringmaster's daughter, comes between them.

Titles.jpn: 父さんは、父さんなんだぞ!

Summaries.eng: Exhausted and feeling unloved by his six sons, Dad runs away from home and pledges to raise fellow runaway Chibita.

Titles.eng: The Tomboy Princess of Dekapan Castle!
Titles.jpn: デカパン城のオテンバ姫!

Summaries.eng: In the Edo era, Minister Iyami secretly plots to have Princess Totoko assassinated so his own son, Hatabou, can take the reins of power.

Titles.eng: It's Tough Being a Champion of Justice-zansu!
Titles.jpn: 正義の味方はつらいザンス

Summaries.eng: Oden Chibita X fights for love, justice and truth, but then Buck Teeth Man gets in on the act and steals his thunder.

Titles.jpn: チビ太の宝島

Summaries.eng: Chibita sets off for adventure with his grandfather's treasure map in hand, but is soon captured by pirates.

Titles.jpn: お年寄りをいたわるザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami and Chibita pose as a poor elderly couple in order to sponge off of Osomatsu's family.

Titles.jpn: 討ち入りには、ご用心ザンス

Summaries.eng: After feudal lord Hatabou is forced into committing seppuku, his loyal retainers, led by Chibita, plot revenge against the power-hungry Iyami.

Titles.jpn: 子守りはつらい仕事ザンス

Summaries.eng: Osomatsu and his brothers are forced to babysit their dad's boss's violent, insomniac son.

Titles.jpn: 摩天楼のホワイトクリスマス

Summaries.eng: Chibita is a bellboy working at the Dayon Hotel when he takes in Totoko, a poor girl who's lost her beautiful singing voice.

Titles.jpn: イヤミのインチキ商売ザンス

Summaries.eng: Chibita becomes apprentice to Iyami, a small-time con man, but their plans go awry when they swindle, Dayon, an off-duty police officer.

Titles.jpn: レースはズルして勝つザンス

Summaries.eng: The usual gang competes in a wacky car race to sweep the wealthy Totoko off her feet.

Titles.jpn: イヤミのデタラメ日本ザンス

Summaries.eng: French director Iyami and his cameraman Chibita travel to Japan to film a documentary on the "real Japan."

Titles.jpn: スキー旅行はチビチイザンス

Summaries.eng: Pretending to be a ski instructor, Iyami goes to a resort with Osomatsu and his brothers, but runs afoul of Chibita, a former co-worker with a grudge.

Titles.jpn: ねっけつ! チビ太刑事ザンス

Summaries.eng: Detective Chibita is transferred to a town where oden is prohibited, but is sold in a black market controlled by a shady character.

Titles.jpn: 宝くじで大金持ちザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami is stunned to find he's won a lottery jacpot on a ticket he made his pal Chibita purchase a year earlier, but only has one day left to collect.

Titles.eng: The Boys Learn Manners at a Zen Temple!
Titles.jpn: ゼン寺修行で六つ子もよい子

Summaries.eng: Osomatsu and his brothers are sent to a zen temple to be straightened out by Iyami, a monk who's in it for the money.

Titles.jpn: お巡りさんでいばるザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami is a crooked police officer who plays pachinko, steals fruit and tries to pick up women while he's on duty.

Titles.jpn: 恐竜たまごのオムレツザンス!

Summaries.eng: In the primitive age, Chibita is a cook at Iyami's dinosaur egg omelet restaurant when he finds a baby T-rex that he wants to keep as a pet.

Titles.eng: What Happens at the Inn Stays at the Inn-zansu!
Titles.jpn: 旅のハジはかきすてザンス!

Summaries.eng: Osomatsu and his family stay at a cheap inn while on vacation, but realize too late that it's actually an extrememly expensive place way beyond their budget.

Titles.jpn: 正しいイヤミはめいわくダス

Summaries.eng: Dr. Hatabou creates an explosive lie detector belt for inveterate liar Iyami, which painfully straightens out the con artist, but that causes even more chaos.

Titles.jpn: ゴマすりゴルフで出世ザンス

Summaries.eng: When Iyami and the sextuplets' father are both up for an important promotion, the president has his son, Chibita, decide who it'll be after playing golf with Iyami and Osomatsu

Titles.jpn: イヤミさんの結婚式だジョー

Summaries.eng: Poverty-stricken Iyami falls for a beautiful, wealthy young woman who feels the same way about him, except she has no idea just how poor he is.

Titles.eng: Luck Ran Out on the Drive.
Titles.jpn: ドライブしたのがウンのつき

Summaries.eng: Dad and the boys have major troubles when they encounter Iyami while on the road in their "new" decrepit used car.

Titles.jpn: 大富豪チビ太さまザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami has a hard time trying to change all the restaurants in town to oden joints in order to please the mega-rich Chibita.

Titles.jpn: イヤミのヒコーキ野郎ザンス

Summaries.eng: Iyami pilots a rickety plane to Hawaii, but it gets hijacked en route.

Titles.eng: Sheee! A 50,000 Yen a Day Allowance!
Titles.jpn: シェ～! こずかい毎日五万円

Summaries.eng: Osomatsu is adopted by the wealthy Dekapan and his wife, but finds them to be overprotective, to say the least.

Titles.eng: Hatabou is a Champion of Justice-dajou!
Titles.jpn: ハタ坊は正義の味方だジョー

Summaries.eng: Presidential candidate Iyami hires hitman Jou Hatabou to take out his rival, Dayon.

Titles.jpn: 空とぶチビ太の仕返しザンス

Summaries.eng: Chibita and Iyami take revenge against the bullying Osomatsu and his brothers via remote-controlled model airplanes.

Titles.eng: Which is More Important, Oden or Your First Love?
Titles.jpn: おでんと初恋どちらがだいじ

Summaries.eng: Chibita is smitten with Jajako, Hatabou's cousin, but she hates his favorite thing in the world, oden.

Titles.jpn: パパのボーナスどこいった?

Summaries.eng: When Dad loses his bonus, suspicion quickly falls on Iyami, who's actually turned over a new leaf.

Titles.jpn: ゾロゾロ六つ子が一ダース!

Summaries.eng: Osomatsu unwittingly makes a duplicate of himself in Dr. Iyami's three-dimensional copy machine.

Titles.jpn: ちびざるチビ太の大冒険!

Summaries.eng: The powerful, rambunctious Chibita Songoku is imprisoned under a rock for 500 years before being rescued by an ambitious monk, Iyami.

Titles.jpn: トト子のわがままオシャカ様

Summaries.eng: Iyami seeks to steal Totoko Buddha's sutras so he can kickstart his own religion, but they're alread held as collateral by moneylender and Chibita's former master, Hatabou.

Titles.jpn: イヤミの教師ビンビン物語!?

Summaries.eng: Nasty teacher Iyami is tormented by Chibita, the one student who dotes on him.

Titles.eng: Life is Tough for Prince Chibita!
Titles.jpn: チビ太の王子様はつらいよ

Summaries.eng: Stifled by his royal burdens and constant handlers, Prince Chibiru slips the leash and finds action in a local department store as he gives chase to a pickpocket, Iyami.

Titles.jpn: イヤミのインチキ海の家!

Summaries.eng: Dad and the boys think they're getting a good deal by hanging out at Iyami's Beach House, but the owner and his assistant, Chibita, gouge their guests for everything they're worth.

Titles.jpn: 魔法を使って若がえるザンス

Summaries.eng: Mom and Dad get to start their lives over again thanks to a magic wish that reverts them to teenagers.

Titles.jpn: ボクシングって痛いザンス!

Summaries.eng: Oden stand owner Chibita trains to fight the Akatsukadai boxing champion, Iyami.

Titles.jpn: 母さんは天才セールスマン!?

Summaries.eng: It's a war between the parents when Dad becomes frustrated that Mom is a better salesperson than he is.

Titles.jpn: みつばちチビ太のバイオリン

Summaries.eng: Honeybee Chibita is in search of his long-lost mother, but his quest is impeded by a trickster, Iyami Katydid, and the ravenous Dayon Spider.

Titles.jpn: トトコは天才なぞなぞ少女!

Summaries.eng: Ridde Temple Master Dekapan gives monks Iyami and Chibita the challenge of stumping locals with riddles.

Titles.eng: Detective Iyami versus Phantom Thief Dayon!
Titles.jpn: 探偵イヤミ対怪人ダヨン面相

Summaries.eng: Inspector Chibita teams up with "great detective" Iyami to capture Phantom Thief Dayon.

Titles.jpn: 四十年後のイヤミザンス!

Summaries.eng: 30 years later, Osomatsu and his brothers are middle-aged salarymen scientists slaving away under their boss, Dekapan, and his demanding daughter, Totoko.

Titles.eng: Deformed in Front of the Camera-zansu!
Titles.jpn: カメラの前でべろ〜んザンス

Summaries.eng: Iyami is driven mad by the desperate measures he takes to sell lousy camera film for his failing company.

Titles.jpn: おそうじロボのソージ君ダス

Summaries.eng: Dekapan invents an artificially intelligent vaccum cleaner that goes out of control and threatens to destroy the country.

Titles.eng: God, Make My Wish Come True!
Titles.jpn: 神さまお願いきいてチョ

Summaries.eng: God (Dekapan) grants Chibita the power to make all of his wishes come true.

Titles.jpn: チビ太のまぶたの母ザンス

Summaries.eng: Chibita's mother comes back into his life by having him kidnapped away from Dekapan, the poor man who raised him.

Titles.jpn: イヤミの冬ごもり作戦ザンス

Summaries.eng: With winter on its way, Iyami wants to be jailed for the sake of shelter and warm meals, but all of his attempted crimes turn into good deeds.

Titles.eng: Raking It In As a Quack!
Titles.jpn: ニセ医者でぼろもうけザンス

Summaries.eng: Would-be burglar Iyami is drafted into posing as the director of a hospital, a ruse that works until he's forced to treat a yakuza boss.

Titles.jpn: 怖い夢は見たくないザンス!

Summaries.eng: Iyami is haunted in his dreams by the spirit of a vengeful samurai, Chibita.

Titles.jpn: 怒ると怖いライオンザンス!

Summaries.eng: When Iyami's circus goes out of business, he gives the lion to the Matsuno family, which doesn't sit well with Chibita, the lion's only friend.

Titles.jpn: ハタ坊の水戸黄門だジョー

Summaries.eng: In ancient Japan, secret retired vice-shogun Hatabou and his companions go up against crooked magistrate Iyami.

Titles.jpn: また来たザンスよエイリアン

Summaries.eng: To prepare for invading Earth, aliens abduct Iyami and sift through memories of his worst moments.

Titles.jpn: イヤミの選挙必勝法ザンス

Summaries.eng: In the final episode, when everyone wants to beat up Iyami and Chibita, it seems their only escape is a long swim across the Pacific.
